channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Steve Mills | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Steve Mills from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Steve Mills
item.description:
Statement from David Fizdale:

“Coaching the New York Knicks has been a great honor and I appreciate Steve Mills, Scott Perry and Jim Dolan for providing me with this opportunity. There are lessons we take with us from every life experience and I am especially grateful for the lessons I have learned from the extraordinary group of people within the MSG family - from the players, coaches, development staff, and trainers to the arena crew, concession workers and ushers - who have all treated me and my family so well during our time with the team.”

David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Dec 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Steve Mills
item.description:
David Fizdale:

“Scott Perry and Steve Mills have done a heck of a job laying this thing out. We’ve got the most cap space. We have seven picks over five years, which means whoever we do get, we can continue to build around them, and I think that’s a great position to be in. We did all that in a course of a year and we laid down our culture, so I’m really excited about where we’re at.”

David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Apr 22, 2019. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Steve Mills
item.description:
Joakim Noah on day in Denver:

“Things escalated. They should never escalate like that between a coach and player. I'm not going to throw Jeff under the bus. I'm not going to talk sh-t about Steve (Mills). I know what I could have done better. Ten things went wrong that day.”

Joakim Noah on Steve Mills, Feb 3, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: Adam Silver on James Dolan, Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Mark Jackson
item.description:
Stephen A Smith to Adam Silver on supporting Mark Jackson bc Knicks need a spokesperson:

“I like Steve Mills & Scott Perry but they need a voice that speaks to the media every day & it can't be one of the players & we both know it'll never be James Dolan.”

Adam Silver on James Dolan, Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Mark Jackson, Apr 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Steve Mills
item.description:
Vogel said Tuesday before Knicks-Magic.

“I interviewed with (ex-Knicks president) Phil (Jackson) and Steve Mills and we had a good couple days together and they said they had one more person they wanted to talk to before they wrapped up the process. But they felt good about it and they met with Jeff (Hornacek) and Jeff must have blown them away because they ended up going with Jeff. And I think that was a good choice because Jeff's a helluva coach and he's done a helluva job under a difficult circumstance here.”

Frank Vogel on Steve Mills, Apr 4, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Scott Perry on Steve Mills
item.description:
“Again, Steve Mills, who I worked with very closely in this process, I have a lot of trust and faith in him. The organization has been very welcoming of me. I'm very confident in who I am as a person and am confident in the vision that's been set here.”

Scott Perry on Steve Mills, Jul 21, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Phil Jackson, Steve Mills
item.description:
Hornacek said.

“If we think that we can somehow -- with a fresh start of training camp and go to it right off the bat, if that helps us and Phil [Jackson] and Steve [Mills] -- we think maybe the same guys on this team could have a different outlook on it, then we'll stay the same. If not, they'll look at other guys.”

Jeff Hornacek on Phil Jackson, Steve Mills, Mar 22, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: James Dolan on Steve Mills
item.description:
Jared Zwerling:Dolan on Mills:

“He is a well-respected sports executive w/ a strong background in basketball, as well as a familiarity w/ NBA operations.”

James Dolan on Steve Mills, Sep 26, 2013. Source: Twitter @JaredZwerling.
